balls.text: attempted yorker, ends up being a full toss, Johnson makes room and thrashes that over the long-off boundary, into the stands
appalling stuff, five wides, down the leg side, misdirected from the bowler, way down the leg side and it was out of Bisla's reach
low full toss, driven uppishly towards long-off, a little wide of him and Karthik forces him to come back for the second
Karthik will feel he missed out there, was fullish on the pads and he tried to flick it fine, was struck on the pads
sits up as a length ball, on middle and he smashes that hard over the bowler's head for a flat six

Narine drops it and messes it up completely, welcome runs for Mumbai, top edge as he goes for the pull, Narine is running in from fine leg and he spills it diving forward, can't get his body behind the ball either and it rolls over the ropes for four
pitched up outside off and that's well fielded by Kallis at mid-off, driven hard and he fields diving to his right
slaps that hard but straight to long-off, just the single
closer to the stumps, turns away sharply and goes past the outside edge as he tries to defend
tossed up outside off, turns away after pitching, misses as he tires to drive
Mumbai losing it here, another run-out, that's an inside edge to short fine leg, there was never a run in there, he goes for it, has been run out with a direct hit from Yusuf
fires it down the leg side and that's a freebie, clips it down to the fine-leg boundary
flat and hard, wide of off and called by the umpire
short on the off, he pulls it away over square leg and that lands short of the boundary, a one bounce four

nicely cut but Balaji has done some outstanding work at third man, cut away to his right, he moved quick from third man and dived to his right to stop that, then returned a superb throw to the keeper, right over the stumps, Rayudu had called for a second, was sent back, slipped and then fell short of the crease as Bisla took off the bails, KKR have hit back well here
McLaren has struck out two big wickets this over, short and Pollard goes for the pull again, a bit of extra bounce and he gets a top-edge, Narine at short fine leg takes it comfortably
slower one bowled short on the off and Pollard pulls it well, just manages to clear midwicket who is right at the circle
short and he tries to pull that past square leg, struck in the midriff, dot
banged it short on middle, Pollard moves across to pull it, seemed a touch too high but the umpire didn't call it a wide

Smart catch from Eoin Morgan, bowled short and Rohit pulled it, Morgan was the man at deep square leg, caught it, lost his balance and stepped over the ropes but he had released the ball by then, got his feet back into the playing field at the right time and completed the catch, smart work
Karthik sends that into the crowd, swung it hard with the turn from off stump and smashed it over deep midwicket
short, pulls it to the right of deep midwicket, just the single
the doosra and this one is defended watchfully back to the bowler
the doosra, punched off the back foot wide of long-off for a couple of runs, took on Abdulla there
swung away towards deep midwicket for a single

shortish outside off, Karthik makes room and slaps it towards deep cover for a couple. Dharmasena signals "one short". Karthik grounded his bat well outside the crease there, good spot from the umpire
errs in length, lands it on a length, Rohit picks it, gets under that one and launches it over the long-on boundary, clean strike
converts it into a yorker, a fullish delivery, comes down the track and digs it out to the bowler
finds the gap, the slower legcutter, made a bit of room and slashed it between point and short third man for four
low full toss, difficult to get those away, gets it as far as long-on, on the bounce, just the single
pushes that through the line towards long-off for a single
drives that one well on the up but straight to extra cover, just the single for Karthik
shortish on the off, tapped into the leg side off the back foot for a single
on a good length, gets forward and defends that carrom ball into the off side
shortish on middle, was the carrom ball, knocked down into the leg side in the directio of midwicket, the fielder takes a while to run in from the deep, they steal two
tossed up on the off, drives that one towards long-on for a single
gets forward and nudges that wide of the bowler for a single
ooh, shortish, turning in, the cut was on but Karthik missed it, some extra bounce for Narine
floating it on the off, comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler
angling in towards middle, defended in front of cover and he sets off
defends that one into the off side and steals a single

Smith holes out, that swing across the line had worked for him earlier in the innings but he fetches this from outside off, tossed up from Abdulla, and sends it straight into the hands of McLaren at long-on
shortish on the off, slapped off the back foot to the left of deep cover for a couple of runs, century up for Mumbai Indians
tossed up, lands in the slot for Smith outside off and he drives that superbly and powerfully to the deep extra cover boundary, landed just inside the ropes
Bowled'im, Bhatia gets rid of Tendulkar, slower ball on leg stump, Tendulkar shuffled and tried to paddle that fine, missed and middle and leg were knocked back
bowled on a length on the off, struck straight to long-on for a single
slower one bowled short on the off, tries to swing it away, mistimes it towards deep midwicket for a single, they thought of a couple but it wasn't on despite a Kallis fumble
slower one, swings that one wide of wide long-on for a couple of runs

appeal for lbw but Tendulkar motions to the umpire saying he played it, gets across and paddles it fine, may have come off the glove, he shows the glove to the bowler and umpire, may have come off the glove and then gone on to flick the pad
short of a length, gets on the back foot and punches it to long-off
well struck and was in the air for a bit but landed just short of extra cover, no single on offer
hammered, Tendulkar had made up his mind, made some room and flat-batted that over the bowler's head
width, chopped away towards deep point for a single
slower through the air, waits for it and reverse-pulls it to short third man, can't get it past the fielder
short on middle, Tendulkar gets on the back foot and pulls it to deep midwicket for a single
short outside off, slapped away towards deep cover for a single
poor ball, short on leg stump, Tendulkar swivels and pulls it away to the fine-leg boundary, two poor balls down the leg side in two overs
low full toss outside off, guides that one towards third man for a single
bowled on a length on the off, strikes it straight to midwicket, no single on offer there
banged in short, gets back to pull it square, mistimes it for a single
short of a good length, pushed off the back foot to extra cover for a quick single
on a good length, Tendulkar makes room and cracks that through point into the deep for a single
short outside off, cut away straight to point
bad ball and Abdulla knows it, full outside leg stump and Smith sweeps it on its way to the fine-leg boundary
shorter from Abdulla, Smith gets on the back foot to pull it over midwicket, it turns away and misses the bat
flatter on middle, Tendulkar makes room and eases that through cover for a single
shortish on the off, slapped off the back foot towards deep cover for a single
Smith swings and misses, tries to smack that over midwicket, misses as it turns away
back of a length, that's been pulled to the left of deep square leg for a single
short of a length, tries to chop it past point, misses
it's the second time he's done that today, pitched up and that's drilled but straight to mid-off
nicely hit but straight to deep midwicket, swings it away into the deep from outside off
slightly short on the off, stabs it wide of point for a single
on a good length on the off, gets across and clips it through square leg for a single
slower through the air, short outside off and that one is cut straight to point
tries to repeat that shot and misses this time, was eyeing cow-corner

ooh, that landed smack in between long-on and deep midwicket, reaches for it from outside off and drags it between those two fielders with the swing of the bat, McLaren dived to his right, couldn't reach it, one bounce four
lots of width there and Smith crashes that through cover and point, powerfully struck and there's no stopping that
slaps it back towards the bowler
flat outside off, pushed towards extra cover
slightly short on middle, flicked through square leg for one more, 50 up for Mumbai
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and flicks it through square leg for a couple of runs
bowled that full on middle, drives it towards long-on for a single
short, nicely struck, stands tall, picks the length and smacks it through midwicket for a boundary
banged in short on leg stump, that should be called a wide and is, too high
angling on the pads, walks across to whip it square, struck high on the pads
full outside off and that's driven hard but straight to mid-off, Balaji stops it
flatter on middle, pushed away into the leg side for a single
floating on middle, gets forward and plays it gently in front of deep midwicket to pick a couple of runs
beaten, this one went the other way and Smith didn't pick it, played inside the line, went past the outside edge
shortish on the off, turns in and catches him high on the pads as he tries to play it off the back foot
turning in from middle and down leg again, struck on the pads as he rocked forward
turns in from the off stump, may have missed leg as he got across to play it into the leg side
shortish on the off, punched off the back foot towards mid-off to steal a single
slower ball gone bad, too wide outside off, called
Smith tries to pull that hard through midwicket, was short, got an inside edge onto his pads
edged, short of a good length, tried to open the face, got it much finer than he would have wanted, a single to third man
slower one bowled full outside leg stump, a wide down the leg side, rare lapse this spell from Bala
tries to fetch that one from outside off to paddle it fine, was hit on the pads there
charged out to Balaji, he held it back and Tendulkar was left to defend it awkwardly into the leg side
angling in towards middle and leg, pushed through midwicket in the deep for a single
a touch lucky there but he'll take it, short of a length, made room to cut it over point, got a thick edge and there was no chance there for Bisla to stop that moving to his right
full toss and that's well timed, on the off stump and that's punched through point this time, beats the dive, four more, four in a row
slower one and he picks it well, McLaren undoing what Balaji did in the previous over, Tendulkar dispatches that over mid-on
banged in short and Tendulkar pulls that hard over midwicket, connected well again, four more
ooh, just clears mid-off, pitched up on the off and he launched it over that fielder, was struck hard, came off the meat and just cleared the fielder
that moved away from a good length, tried to smash that over extra cover, had to reach for it, went past the edge
good stuff from Bala, Smith gets across and drives that cautiously towards mid-on
frustration for Smith, goodish length, charges down the track to smack him over mid-off, misses
takes off from a good length and Smith plays a little inside the line to that one, beaten
rocks forward and opens the face to play that one towards third man for a single
on a good length, gets a stride out and pushes that one towards mid-on
angling towards middle and leg, turns that one towards short fine for a single
on the off stump, flicks it away through midwicket into the deep for a single
in the slot outside off, cracks it straight to mid-off this time
superbly done, even better than the previous one, this one was imperious, half-volley on middle and he stands tall to dispatch it down the ground
nice drive down the ground, just a punch, angling in towards middle and he cracks that down the pitch and past mid-on
down the leg side, good collect by the keeper as he dives to his left
angling in towards the off stump, pushes that one well towards mid-off
lovely drive, fullish outside off, Gambhir at cover point dives to his right to stop that, they get a single
gets an inside edge as that one moves back in from outside off, Smith tries to punch that towards cover, gets an inside edge on the pads

ooh, angling in towards middle, Smith doesn't get bat to it as he walks forward to defend it, struck him low n front of middle and leg, a little high on the back pad, may have gone over, may have even missed leg
ooh, went off the back pad, angled in towards off and then darted away, clipped the back pad on the way to the keeper, and landed short of the keeper
leaves this one alone, in the channel outside off, shoulders arms
fullish on the off, rocks back and defends it towards cover from the crease
swung away, landed on a good length, Smith tried to smash that past mid-off, missed it as it went past the outside edge
KKR have been bowled out, bowled it full on middle and Balaji failed to keep it out, was the slower yorker, he had no answer
slower one, didn't pick it, checked his shot in the end, lobbed up towards a vacant extra cover region
swings and misses, short and he tries to go over midwicket, doesn't connect
dropped that short on middle and he gets out of the way
there was a sound, Narine walked as well, short and wide, tried to flat-bat that, got a feather to the keeper, Karthik was convinced, Johnson became convinced
that clips the pads, Tendulkar runs across from fine leg, misfields while trying to collect and throw, concedes an extra run
a leg-bye towards square leg
Narine makes room, Johnson follows, gets a thick edge to third man for a single
bowled it full on leg stump, makes room and slices that towards point for
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and chips it in the vacant midwicket region
slower one, turns out to be a slow full toss, pushed towards mid-on for a single
slower one bowled on a length, pushes it towards point
short on middle and punches it over Tendulkar at extra cover, got it high on the bat did Narine
banged it short on the off, he swayed out of the way of that one
Harbhajan picks another one, short and he goes for the pull, a bit of extra bounce there for Harbhajan, he gets a top edge and Malinga runs to his left at short fine and takes a good catch
short on middle, moves away and guides it towards short third for a single
shortish outside off, comes down the track and plays it down towards point for a single
short, pulled towards deep square leg for a couple of runs
tossed up outside off, tries to drive him through extra cover, gets a thick edge as it turns away, just the single
comes down the track and defends it back to the bowler
yorker length outside off, dug out towards extra cover for a single
short of a good length, gets on the back foot and knocks it down into the off side
banged in short on middle and he ducks under it well
short outside off, guided past point, wide of third man, Nechim dives to his left to stop that
low full toss on middle, yorker at 137.2, pushed towards long-off

slow full toss, pushed towards midwicket, Mclaren calls for a single and is then sent back, it's a poor throw but Karthik collects well and flicks the ball back onto the stumps, McLaren dives but is short

Harbhajan does a lap past extra cover and then towards the boundary, doesn't dance but holds his finger to his lips to indicate silence, short outside off and it goes on straight, Das tries to turn the face, gets a leading edge, Harbhajan had to move past the non-striker there to take that catch and he did it well
flat but a full toss and Das thwacks that over Harbhajan's head for a one bounce four
slightly short on middle, gets on the back foot and punches it to the bowler
gets forward and drives it back again to Harbhajan
slaps it straight back towards the bowler
Debabrata has a lot of fight left in him, round the wicket and that's full on middle, he goes hard over deep midwicket and clears it comfortably
beaten, on a good length, nips away and McLaren pushes at it inside the line to be beaten
punches it towards mid-off off the front foot for a single
short of a good length, tries to punch it off the back foot, gets an inside edge onto the pads
fullish and he opens the face to play that behind point for a single
Morgan goes and with that you would think KKR are out of this game, full outside off and he slices that straight to Rohit Sharma at point, who takes a good low catch
goodish length on the off, defends it towards point from the crease
dispatched, picks the length, rocks back as it turns in and pulls it hard over the deep midwicket boundary, a lot more to be done still
tries to force it into the leg side, struck on the thigh
shortish on the off, cut just wide of point for a single
tries to force that into the leg side off the back foot, gets a leading edge towards long-off
may have been the doosra, gets back and taps it down into the leg side
flat on the off, drops it in front of point for a single
pushed off the front foot into the off side, no run on offer

appeal for lbw, looked close, was there an inside edge? Angling in towards middle, got across to play it into the leg side, struck on the pads. Simon Taufel on TV commentary thinks there's an inside edge, didn't seem like it to me. Das was lucky
tries to reverse-sweep that one past point, clips the pads and lobs up over the keeper
drives that towards long-off for a single
stabs that towards cover from the crease, no single there
off the mark in style, short outside off, waited for it to turn away and slashed it past point for a boundary
sliding on the pads, tries to tickle that one fine, clips the pads on the way to the fine-leg boundary
Kallis has holed out now, Harbhajan bowled to him from round the wicket, Kallis charged out and tried to clear long-off, mistimed it and offered a simple catch to fielder there
pushed away into the leg side
shortish outside off, slapped towards deep cover for a single
knocked away into the off side in front of point for one more
tossed up outside off, slices that past point into the deep for a single
slightly short on the off, gets on the back foot and knocks it into the leg side
innovation right away, reverse-sweeps that well towards deep point, Smith runs a few yards to his right to stop that
tickled off the front foot behind square on the leg side
Yusuf goes! Looked ugly, the dismissal, flat outside off and he tried to slam that over long-on, got an inside edge onto the stumps, KKR in trouble now
flighted outside of, drives it towards long-off for a single
tossed up outside off, Yusuf goes after that one but doesn't connect well enough, hits it to Pollard on the bounce for a single
on off and middle, moved well across and flicked it fine but straight to short fine leg
on middle and leg, clipped away towards fine leg for a single
on a good length this time, Yusuf gets forward and drives it back to the bowler
Yusuf settling in well, seized the length early there, short on the off and that was pulled away powerfully through deep midwicket
shortish on the off, chopped towards third man for a single
full on middle and leg, drives it straight to Tendulkar at midwicket, big cheers
quicker through the air on the off stump, defended towards extra cover
Yusuf doesn't take long to announce himself, flat on the off and that's been slog-swept miles over the deep midwicket boundary
this one is driven well to the left of extra cover for a single into the deep
tossed up outside off and that's driven straight towards extra cover, Harbhajan dives to his left and pulls off a good save
floated that one outside off, sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for a single
Ojha strikes, Bisla goes, tossed up, Bisla stepped out of the crease to drive that inside out over extra cover, it turned away sharply to go past the bat and Karthik did the rest
swings that one towards deep square leg for a single
bowled it full outside off, lucky is Bisla, was looking to turn that into the leg side, gets an outside edge to the third-man boundary
slower one bowled short on the off, whipped past midwicket for a single
bowled that short outside off and he sways out of the way, bowled at 142.4kmph
slower one on middle and leg, didn't pick it as he tried to flick it through the leg side, cut back in and struck him high on the pads, may have missed leg as well
goodish length and he opens the face to guide that past point into the deep for a single
Bisla tries to make room and Johnson chases him again, that zips through him as he is cramped for room and goes through to the keeper
bowled it full on the off, drives it towards mid-on from the crease
Bisla had made up his mind to go after that one, charged down the pitch, Johnson chased him, tried to swing it over midwicket, was struck on the thighs
slightly short on middle, turns it through square leg into the deep for a single
drops that short outside off, chops that towards slip on the bounce
goodish length on the off, tries to punch it past extra cover, gets an inside edge onto the pads
improvisation from Bisla, comes down the track, flicks it away from the off stump over square leg, struck it well enough to take it to the boundary
tossed up on the off, drives it straight towards long-off for a single
tries to swing it over square leg, gets an inside edge past the keeper for a single
short down the leg side, gets across to sweep it hard behind square, misses
comes down the track and turns it into leg for a single
slightly short on the off, played away into the off side for a single
lovely drive, pitched up on the off stump and he drives that through the line, past the non-striker to beat mid-off to the ropes
ooh, on a good length and Bisla tried to drive that through the line, missed
shortish on leg stump and that's been played down to fine leg for a single
banged in short and Kallis has top-edged that, tried to pull it square and it took the edge and sailed over the keeper's head
Harbhajan has dropped it at slip,straightforward chance, on a driving length and he goes hard at it, gets a thick edge and Harbhajan had to move just a little to his right to snap that, made a mess
on a good length, gets forward and defends it towards extra cover off the front foot
short and wide and Kallis dispatches that supremely, cut away hard over the deep point boundary
banged in short and Kallis pulls and pulls well and he finds the deep square leg boundary
reaches to play that one out, moving away and Kallis can't get to it, made a bit of room there, was close to the wide marker outside off
on a good length and pushes that one on the up towards cover
bowled in the channel outside off, leaves that one alone, moves away after pitching
short of a good length, gets on the back foot and punches it towards cover
full, on off, swinging in slightly, driven to mid-off
short of a length, middle and leg, worked away to leg
Johnson breaks through. This is the first ball that hasn't swung. Gambhir plays for the swing, and gets an inside edge onto the stumps. Superb over so far
Jonhson is swinging it. It's the good Mitch that has turned up again. Defended just outside off
more swing. From just short of a length, into the thigh pad. They take a leg-bye
and he gets swing first ball, only an inside edge saves him
